neighborhoods.name: Wendell
neighborhoods.description: One of the fastest-growing towns in North Carolina, with newer housing stock, small-town charm, and a historic Main Street.

highlights.highlight: Population up 114% since 2020 — fastest growth in NC
Newest housing stock of any town in the state
Historic downtown with an active Main Street district

neighborhoods.name: Zebulon
neighborhoods.description: A historic railroad town turned Wake County growth story, sitting right at the crossroads of Highways 64 and 264.

highlights.highlight: Direct access to Raleigh via US-64
Recently awarded $2.1M+ for new community park development

neighborhoods.name: Garner
neighborhoods.description: A Wake County value leader just south of Raleigh, with strong new-construction inventory and a revitalizing historic downtown.

neighborhoods.name: Four Oaks
neighborhoods.description: A close-knit Johnston County town offering genuine affordability and small-town character, with easy access to the wider Triangle region.

highlights.highlight: Among the most affordable towns in the region
Historic Commercial District listed on the National Register of Historic Places

neighborhoods.name: Rocky Mount
neighborhoods.description: An established Nash/Edgecombe County hub along I-95, offering real affordability and a stable, historic community.

highlights.highlight: Historic Rocky Mount Mills district with shops, dining, and events
Direct I-95 access to the entire East Coast corridor

neighborhoods.name: Goldsboro
neighborhoods.description: A Wayne County community anchored by Seymour Johnson Air Force Base, offering strong affordability for military families and civilians alike.

highlights.highlight: Home to Seymour Johnson AFB's 4th Fighter Wing
Cost of living roughly 22% below the national average
Cliffs of the Neuse State Park just 15 minutes away
